## Stop before posting

Do not post live secrets or exploit details publicly.

Do not include:

- private keys
- seed phrases
- mnemonic phrases
- wallet files
- keystore files
- API tokens
- RPC credentials
- screenshots containing secrets
- exploit steps that could put users, funds, validators, or node operators at risk

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting / Security Advisories if available.

If private reporting is unavailable, open a minimal issue that says you have a security-sensitive report and wait for private contact instructions.

## Minimal public description

Describe the affected area without revealing exploit details:

- participant UI
- node runtime
- validator flow
- Buy VOID
- Work Credits
- DataNet
- wallet handling
- public docs
- other

## Confirmation

- [ ] I did not include live secrets.
- [ ] I did not include exploit instructions.
- [ ] I understand public active validator admission, treasury spend, Buy VOID fulfillment, and authority transfer remain guarded.
